# sommarioz

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The most important function in $\textsf{R}$ is the **summary()** function. So, if one fits any statistical model or generates a near-optimal statistical design, then one should summarize the model or the design with the appropriate statistical measures.

The Italian word for *summary* is *sommario*!

The goal of sommarioz is to provide functions and data sets that are used in the case-studies of the e-book (Biometry:The 5Rs).

The link to the e-book is <http://mario24freo.github.io/Biometry_The_5Rs> which is in a draft/development phase and version 1 is planned to be released on December 1, 2026.

Also, under construction is the other e-book :
<http://mario24freo.github.io/PizzaRioZ> and version 1 is also planned to be released on December 1, 2026.

Please note, that since the arrival of AI agents such as "Claudio" (claude-ai pro), it is sometimes more efficient to ask Claudio to construct some R functions. These are identified with the suffix (.cai) and my functions that I have written are identified by the suffix (.soz).


## Installation

You can install the development version of sommarioz from
[GitHub](https://github.com/mario24Freo/sommarioz) with:

``` r
remotes::install_github("mario24Freo/sommarioz")
```
